window.note: THE WATCH IS ARMED, AND WHAT IT WATCHES CANNOT BE BOUGHT WITH VOLUME. The build is done and green; the claim it cannot settle is whether the read made the Law 6 refusal BIND, because every crossing in this system is made by one hand and a gate that admits exactly that hand is indistinguishable from a gate that admits everyone. Falsifier clause (3) — every boat's owner resolving to one string — is ALREADY TRUE at n=2 and no amount of building escapes it here. So the probe's `enough` requires a SECOND DISTINCT ACTOR on a cleared crossing, expressed as len(distinct_actors) >= 2 rather than as 'not CC': hard-coding the hand would strand a learned value in a human's head and go stale the day a second device is named. Its trigger's condition (a) — a cleared crossing whose actor the boat does not admit — has no sample floor, because one record proves it and waiting for twenty would be waiting to confirm what the first showed. Condition (b) is falsifier clause (3) as a trend, and it requires the corpus to collapse on BOTH axes at once (one owning intention AND one actor), since one intention moving many boats is ordinary and so is one hand moving many intentions' boats. THE PROBE RE-RESOLVES RATHER THAN TRUSTING THE RECORD: the crossing records cleared_by and actor but not the owner the gate resolved, so it opens the boat again and asks whether that actor is admitted — a record carrying the resolved owner would be the gate grading its own homework. Era floor 18:00, between the last crossing cleared by the defective comparison (16:55:29) and this voyage's; those two records stand and are not counted as evidence about their own fix (Law 7). THE VERDICT WAS WRITTEN AND DEPOSITED BEFORE THIS CROSSING: 8 criteria passing, 11 hypotheses dispositioned, one of them a PARTIAL KILL — the prediction that a cleared crossing would honestly read delegated=True is false, because transitions.py:749 renders that field on the standing line, so a constant would mark every crossing delegated and inform nobody. The reasoning was sound and argued for a second field, not for redefining this one.

window.note: THE AUTHORITY RUNG NOW REFUSES SOMETHING. For a year the sentence harbor_master's charter rests on — an actor who is not the boat's owner and holds no grant is refused — was real code that ran and returned the answer its caller asked for, because `actor` and `boat_owner` arrived from the same hand in the same call. The owner is now READ: boat_id -> CairnCommons/tickets/<id>.json -> owning_intention -> that charter -> gated_by, two file opens, no daemon and no registry, every failed hop naming the address it opened and the one line that fixes it. THE COMPARISON CHANGED SHAPE, not just its source, and that is the part worth carrying forward: a hand is never EQUAL to an intention, it is ADMITTED BY one — Law 6's second clause (delegated access through the owner's gate) rather than its first. FOUR ROUTES WERE CLOSED, NOT ONE, because the ticket's own falsifier clause (1) is 'the same hole wearing a different field': the parameter is gone; a boat_owner= keyword RAISES instead of riding **journal_extra into a record of truth (removing the parameter alone would have left that open, and a forged field in a record is worse than a bad argument); mint_grant reads the boat too, so no caller mints itself standing from an owner it invented; and boat_id must agree with the ticket the gates read, which until today could disagree. NON-HOLLOW BY REVERT, BOTH DIRECTIONS: the exploit call PASSES the authority rung on reverted code and is REFUSED on built code — and the ticket's own falsifier was AMBIGUOUS about which way that points, so the unambiguous statement is recorded beside the original rather than written over it, the original being the evidence that this happens at all. WHAT WAS REFUSED ON PURPOSE: clear() takes no tickets_dir=, because root injection hands the caller back the choice of what the gate reads — the same hole in a coat. Consequence accepted: proofs must name REAL boats, so the fixtures are live ticket ids and _OWNER is derived by reading rather than written down. TWO FIELDS DECLARED, NEITHER BACK-FILLED, both distinguished by measurement rather than by assertion: owning_intention on the tickets template (told apart from `intention` and `owner` BY SHAPE — this one resolves, those are prose, over 100 filed tickets) and gated_by on this charter ALONE (22 of 24 beside-code charters carry an `owner` over 60 chars and 2 carry an empty one, so matching an actor against that prose is a substring scan — green for the wrong reason). The fleet-wide fill and the who-may-mint hole are FILED as an-intention-declares-its-gated-hands and cited by address from the code, filed before the teeth rather than after, because a known hole placed after the conformers is how it becomes folklore. A TOOTH WRITTEN WRONG TWICE IS RECORDED IN ITSELF: the reach check was first too narrow (a set that by construction held only cairn.* names, so four forbidden terms were decoration) and then too wide (it swept in the tester and went red over somebody else's correct shelling out — a tooth that fires on normal motion gets silenced, and silencing is how a real signal is trained away). WHAT THIS BUILD CANNOT SETTLE, carried by an instrument instead of an argument: whether the refusal binds anything. One hand moves everything here, so the probe's `enough` demands a second actor and no volume of CC crossings reaches it. That is the honest edge of this voyage, and it is the same edge the ticket named at cast rather than one discovered late.
